summary: Complete UI/UX redesign verification for HYPD Games mobile-first gaming platform. All design features from 'Hook' app reference successfully implemented and tested: floating pill bottom nav, squircle cards, DM Sans font, light/dark mode toggle, pastel gradients, pill-shaped tabs, gradient CTA buttons, backdrop-blur action buttons.

issues: Video preview area shows solid black background for games without video URLs - could look like loading/broken state. Consider showing thumbnail image as fallback (carried over from previous iteration).

passed_tests: Feed page loads with video cards, game info overlays, play/save action buttons visible
Bottom nav pill-shaped bar renders with 5 tabs (Feed, Explore, Defence, Leaders, Profile)
Bottom nav has correct active state (green circle with lime color #AAFF00)
Bottom nav has 999px border-radius (pill shape)
Theme toggle works - switching between dark and light modes on all pages
CSS variables update correctly when toggling themes
Explore page shows sections: new games, categories (gradient tiles), trending (big cards), per-category rows
Explore search functionality works - search icon opens overlay, type to search, results displayed
Leaderboard page shows trophy icon, 'leaderboards' title, pill tabs (Global/By Game), card-style ranked rows
Profile page (logged out) shows auth forms with gradient login CTA button, pill tabs, rounded inputs
Profile page (logged in) shows avatar, stats cards, tab navigation (Streak/Games/Coins/Friends)
Navigation between all pages via bottom nav works correctly
Light mode shows purple gradient bleed at top of Explore/Leaderboard/Profile pages (page-gradient class)
Game cards have squircle (24px) border radius on Explore page
Mobile-first layout with max-width 430px container centered
DM Sans font applied to body
Gradient CTA button has purple gradient (from #7748F8 to #A259FF)
Input fields have 16px border-radius and 56px height
Backdrop-blur (12px) applied to action buttons on feed
Category tiles have gradient backgrounds and 20px border-radius
Leaderboard rows have card styling with 20px border-radius
Stats cards on profile have elevated card styling
Defence/Idle game page loads correctly
critical_code_review_comments: Bottom nav has pointer-events-none on container which requires force=True for Playwright clicks - this is intentional design to allow touch-through but may cause issues with some automation tools
CSS variables system is well-implemented with proper dark/light mode separation
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
